about.title: About us
about.heading: About Rutfinder
about.lead: We bring together in one place the information on ready-to-use therapeutic foods (RUTF) made around the world, so that choosing one is faster and better informed.
about.whyP1: RUTFs are the standard treatment for severe acute malnutrition in children. But information about them is scattered across reports, scientific papers, manufacturer catalogues and spreadsheets.
about.whyP2: Comparing products means searching many places and reconciling data that each source presents in its own way. Rutfinder does that work once, for everyone.
about.s1Text: Reports, peer-reviewed papers, grey literature and manufacturer data.
about.s2Text: Every product has the same sheet: composition, ingredients, production, cost and evidence.
about.s3Text: If a figure isn't known, the sheet says “No data”. Nothing is estimated or filled in.

data.readTitle: How to read a product sheet

exp.smallScale: Made in small plants or by hand.
exp.local: Made close to where it is eaten.
exp.theoretical: A recipe published in a study that is not yet manufactured.
exp.vegetarian: No meat or fish; may contain milk or egg.
exp.peer: The data comes from scientific papers reviewed by other experts.
exp.grey: The data comes from reports, theses or technical documents without peer review.
exp.unicef: The manufacturer supplies this product to UNICEF.
exp.estimated: The source gives a calculated or approximate value, not a measured one.
exp.noData: The source doesn't give this figure. We don't fill it in or estimate it.
